summary.text: Spiral dawn light is a rank eight immortal material that expands like dawn rays when used to build a year essence pool.

claims.text: Fang Yuan tells Xia clan to send spiral dawn light as sincerity before any negotiation. Xia clan produces it, but the production ground is inside the first supreme elder’s immortal aperture, and the clan storage has none left. Spiral dawn light is extremely rare, with no supply even in treasure yellow heaven. Fang Yuan raises the demand from three portions to ten.

Xia clan’s ten portions of spiral dawn light are the first of Fang Yuan’s year essence pool materials to arrive. Spiral dawn light, eight-parts jade, and seven treasures water are among those immortal materials, described as rank eight or as rank seven needed in high quantity.

Spiral dawn light is a rank eight immortal material. In Fang Yuan’s time path clone’s palm it appears as a dreamlike wisp of dawn rays, bright and fresh, constantly rotating. When used, it explodes and covers the surrounding hundred li; it is extremely stretchable, and further lumps dye that range with flickering illusory shadows. With seven treasures water and eight-parts jade it merges without self-disintegrating, allowing the finished year essence pool to expand to ten thousand li when filled.

Origin.text: Xia clan first supreme elder's immortal aperture
